description.subject: A miniature figure with a brown egg in place of a head, standing on a pebble bed and holding a glossy amber sphere against its middle.
description.covering: A red ribbed wool collar rolled up around the base of the egg, a red long-sleeved top, khaki overalls with a front bib and pockets that reach the ankle, white cloth gloves, and tan-orange leather boots.
description.setting: Outdoors on a dense bed of rounded gravel and pebbles in white, tan, rust and slate tones, with the background falling out of focus.
description.light: Soft, warm, low-angled daylight from the upper left, medium-hard, with a golden cast and short gentle shadows between the stones.
description.materials: Eggshell, red wool yarn, khaki cotton twill, white cotton fabric, polished stone pebbles, and tan leather.
description.anomaly: Two tiny hairline cracks on the upper surface of the brown eggshell, standing in for a face on an otherwise smooth egg.
